r2v.name: Reference to Video
r2v.wrap:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is [DESCRIBE THE SUBJECT FROM <Picture 1>: age, hair, clothing, notable features].

summary:
[reference generation] Generate a short video using the provided references: {USER}

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - [WHAT IS KEPT].

detailed_description:
[STATE THE STYLE IN 1-2 SENTENCES BEFORE [Shot 1]]
[Shot 1] [DESCRIBE THE SHOT IN DETAIL, USING <Subject N> / <Picture N> / <Video N> / <Audio N> LABELS].

[1-4 sentences of ambience.]

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

presets.name: Motion reference + your audio
presets.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the person whose appearance comes from <Picture 1> and whose movement and performance come from <Video 1>.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] Generate a video of <Subject 1> performing the movement shown in <Video 1>, speaking in sync with the provided audio <Audio 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity kept exactly as in <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> (motion and performance): weak_reference - only the movement, gestures and pacing are imitated; the person shown in <Video 1> is NOT the subject.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic, live-action style.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in sync with <Audio 1>, imitating the gestures, posture and head movement of <Video 1>, while keeping the exact face, hair and clothing of <Picture 1>. The face of the person in <Video 1> never appears. [DESCRIBE THE SETTING, MOOD AND CAMERA].

overall_soundscape:
The copied audio track <Audio 1> is the complete soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

presets.name: Reuse the video's audio
presets.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the person whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>; their movement and performance come from <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1> where the original performer is replaced by <Subject 1>, keeping the original soundtrack <Audio 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity kept exactly as in <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> (motion, framing and performance): partially_preserved - the performance is re-enacted by <Subject 1>; the original performer does not appear.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic, live-action style.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> (S1) re-enacts the performance of <Video 1> - same gestures, posture, pacing and framing - with the exact face, hair and clothing of <Picture 1>; the soundtrack is the copied <Audio 1>. The face of the person in <Video 1> never appears. [DESCRIBE THE SETTING, MOOD AND CAMERA].

overall_soundscape:
The copied audio track <Audio 1> is the complete soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

keyframes.name: Custom Keyframes
keyframes.wrap:
integrated_multimodal_description:
A single continuous cinematic shot with no cuts.

At the beginning, [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 1 / STARTING SUBJECT AND ENVIRONMENT].

As the shot progresses, [DESCRIBE THE FIRST TRANSFORMATION LEADING TOWARD KEYFRAME 2]. Keep the subject visually continuous - same identity, same screen position, same approximate scale.

Around the midpoint, [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 2 / MIDDLE STATE].

During the second half, [DESCRIBE THE SECOND TRANSFORMATION LEADING TOWARD KEYFRAME 3]. The change happens progressively, never as a sudden replacement.

By the final moments, [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 3 / FINAL STATE].

{USER}

overall_soundscape:
[1-4 sentences of ambience.]

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

presets.name: Morph through keyframes
presets.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
A single continuous cinematic shot with no cuts. The SAME subject in every keyframe - describe its identity once: type, color, shape, distinctive details. It never changes color or turns into a different subject.

At the beginning, the subject matches KEYFRAME 1 exactly: [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 1 / STARTING STATE].

As the shot progresses, [DESCRIBE THE FIRST TRANSFORMATION OR ACTION LEADING TOWARD KEYFRAME 2]. Keep the subject visually continuous - same identity, same screen position, same approximate scale during the transition.

Around the midpoint, the subject matches KEYFRAME 2: [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 2 / MIDDLE STATE].

During the second half, [DESCRIBE THE SECOND TRANSFORMATION OR ACTION LEADING TOWARD KEYFRAME 3]. The change happens progressively rather than as a sudden replacement.

By the final moments, the subject matches KEYFRAME 3: [DESCRIBE KEYFRAME 3 / FINAL STATE].

overall_soundscape:
[1-4 sentences of ambience.]

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

mask.name: Mask Inpaint
mask.wrap:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the replacement whose appearance comes from <Picture 1> and whose movement and performance come from <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] Replace only the tracked masked region in the source video with <Subject 1>: {USER}

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - identity and appearance follow <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> (motion and performance): weak_reference - only the movement, gestures and pacing are imitated; the person shown in <Video 1> is NOT the subject.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The source video keeps its original camera, timing, lighting and unmasked content. Inside the mask, <Subject 1> re-enacts the movement, gestures and pacing of <Video 1> while keeping the exact face, hair and clothing of <Picture 1>; the face of the person in <Video 1> never appears. [DESCRIBE THE REPLACEMENT AND ITS MOTION].

overall_soundscape:
Keep the source soundtrack unchanged.
